name: Amendments by the committee responsible – separate vote
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Erasmus+ programme for the period 2028-2034, and repealing Regulations (EU) 2021/817 and (EU) 2021/888
part_text: (11a) The Programme should strengthen the European dimension of school education through pupil and staff mobility, including short-term mobility, small-scale partnerships, European Teacher Academies and European School Alliances. Such support should widen participation from an early age, promote inclusion and territorial balance, support teachers, and ensure that schools with lower administrative capacity can progressively access European cooperation opportunities.
